title: How a Seed Grows
blurb: Inside every tiny seed there is a sleeping plant. What wakes it up?

chapters.title: A Seed Is Asleep
chapters.text:
Pak Joko is a farmer. He has some rice seeds in his hand.

A seed is small. Some seeds are tiny. Some seeds are big. A bean is a seed. A grain of rice is a seed too.

Inside a seed there is a baby plant. The baby plant is asleep. It waits for water.

What does the baby plant wait for?

chapters.title: Water Wakes It Up
chapters.text:
Pak Joko puts the seeds in wet soil. The soil is soft and dark. The sun makes the soil warm.

Day by day, the seed drinks the water. The seed gets bigger. Then the seed opens. Pop!

A tiny root goes down into the soil. The root holds the plant and drinks more water.

chapters.title: A Little Plant
chapters.text:
Now a green shoot goes up. It goes up to the sun. Two small leaves open. The leaves are green and soft.

The little plant needs water and sun. Every day it grows a little more. After some weeks the rice plant is tall.

Pak Joko smiles. "My seeds are now plants," he says.
